settings_subtitle: Make MyBicocca yours on this device.
settings_appearance_page_subtitle: The app’s theme and colours. Changes apply at once.
settings_theme_description_light: Follow your device (light right now), or always stay light or dark.
settings_theme_description_dark: Follow your device (dark right now), or always stay light or dark.
settings_palette_description: The accent of the whole app. The university’s logo stays crimson.
settings_language_page_subtitle: The app’s language on this device.
settings_language_note: Dates, numbers and grades follow the language too.
settings_language_help_translate: Help us translate the app into {language}!
settings_language_help_translate_body: MyBicocca speaks Italian and English. Until then, it uses Italian.
settings_security_page_subtitle: Protect MyBicocca in this browser with a PIN.
settings_security_on_immediately: Locks as soon as you leave
settings_lock_group_description: Asks for a PIN when you open MyBicocca and when it sits unused.
settings_lock_after_description: When you leave the app or stop using it
settings_lock_now_description: Hide the app until the PIN is entered
settings_lock_note: The PIN protects MyBicocca in this browser only. It’s stored only as a hash, which can’t be turned back into the PIN, and it isn’t your university password. Signing out of every account removes it.
settings_lock_forgot_body: To remove the lock without the PIN, sign out of every account on this browser: their saved data is deleted. Then sign in again with your university credentials.
settings_pin_invalid: The PIN must have {min} to {max} digits.

match.countPlural=one: Wrong PIN. {count} more try before a pause.
match.countPlural=other: Wrong PIN. {count} more tries before a pause.

settings_pin_wait: Too many tries. Try again at {time}.
settings_pin_create_description: We’ll ask for it to open MyBicocca in this browser. Don’t use your university password.
settings_pin_change_description: Confirm your current PIN, then pick the new one.
settings_files_page_subtitle: What happens when you open a course file.
settings_files_ask_description: Choose when you open the file
settings_files_view_description: Opens in the viewer, without downloading
settings_files_note_office: Office documents open in Word, Excel or PowerPoint, or download.
settings_files_note_shift: Shift-click a file to choose again just for it; Ctrl-click opens the preview in a new tab.
settings_about_tagline: Lectures, exams, e-learning, the campus map and services of Milano-Bicocca, in one place.
settings_update_current: You’re on the latest version · checked {time}
settings_update_offline: You’re offline: try again once you’re back online
settings_releases_subtitle: The versions of the Android app
settings_releases_row: What changed in each version of the Android app
settings_releases_android: These notes are written for the Android app, so some changes, such as downloads and gestures, only concern it. The site has no versions to install: it updates when you reload.
settings_releases_error: The release notes couldn’t be loaded from GitHub. Try again in a moment.
settings_releases_rate_limited: GitHub reached its hourly limit of requests from this network. Try again after {time}.
settings_releases_empty_body: The notes will arrive with the first version.
settings_privacy_page_subtitle: How MyBicocca handles your data, in plain words.
settings_privacy_lead: MyBicocca talks to the university for you. What it gets back stays in your browser.
settings_privacy_device_body: Accounts, careers and data already loaded (timetable, exams, courses) are saved in the browser, encrypted with a key the browser keeps and that can’t be exported.
settings_privacy_device_password: Your password is saved only if you choose “Remember on this device”, encrypted the same way, to sign you back in automatically.
settings_privacy_requests_body: Requests go from your browser to the university’s services: Esse3, e-learning and timetables.
settings_privacy_requests_relay: Services that don’t accept requests from other sites go through MyBicocca’s relay, which forwards them and keeps nothing.
settings_privacy_others_body: Release notes and the credits’ photos come from GitHub; recorded lectures come from Kaltura and library bookings from Affluences, services the university uses. They see your IP address, as any website does.
settings_privacy_others_local: Fonts and the campus map are served by MyBicocca itself: no outside map or font service.
settings_privacy_tracking_body: No usage statistics, advertising or tracking cookies, and no MyBicocca account: you sign in with your university credentials only.
settings_privacy_control_body: Signing out of an account deletes everything saved for it from the browser.
settings_privacy_control_lock: Signing out of the last one also removes the app lock’s PIN.
settings_licences_page_subtitle: The free software MyBicocca is built on.
settings_licences_own_body: The code of the Android app and of the site is public on GitHub under the MIT licence: read it, use it and improve it.
settings_licences_search: Search a library or a licence
settings_licences_no_text: The package doesn’t include the text of its {licence} licence: its project has it.
